taskChanges.newValue: Root cause: resourceLabel returned undefined for finite-amount cache entries lacking data.label, causing Resources name sort to call localeCompare on undefined. Added deterministic key-based fallback and a regression test that reproduced the original TypeError before fix. Build now bumps SemVer once after asset compilation, checks source version synchronization and monotonicity, and copies the updated manifest to dist. Updated @doc/workflows/extension-versioning-and-release. Tests: 54 UI/data/version tests pass; npm run build bumped 0.9.34 to 0.9.35 and all four version files agree; Knowns doc/task validation clean. System Decision Impact: version policy recorded in the existing release workflow doc.
